name: Coral Growth Algorithm
definition: A procedural method to generate coral geometry by constructing a tree of spheres. The coral structure is defined as a 'soft object' (contour surface) derived from the sum of spherically symmetric density functions centered at sphere locations.
summary: The Coral Growth Algorithm procedurally generates organic branching volume data via a hierarchical tree of spheres, distinguished by its soft object contouring and strict layer-by-layer generation governed by genealogical collision constraints.
